summary: scripts/st-test's whole-suite run asks the upgrade-impact check (scripts/check-release-impact, from the merge's tree) about the merge of the head with the base before any wait, and stops with the fix when the branch lacks a fresh release-notes/NAME.json; --status shows it as an upgrade-impact warning row that leaves its exit code alone

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: No evidence rule changes; CI's upgrade-impact job is unchanged and still decides.

compatibility.detail: A branch that lacks a release note now stops a whole-suite st-test run before it signs anything, where it used to sign and then fail upgrade-impact in CI. --check runs and --status (so the pre-push hook) do not stop on it. A base without scripts/check-release-impact is not asked.
